name: EPIC-Kitchens 2019 Action Recognition Challenge
description: In this report we describe the technical details of our submission to the EPIC-Kitchens 2019 action recognition challenge. To participate in the challenge we have developed a number of CNN-LSTA [3] and HF-TSN [2] variants, and submitted predictions from an ensemble compiled out of these two model families. Our submission, visible on the public leaderboard with team name FBK-HUPBA, achieved a top-1 action recognition accuracy of 35.54% on S1 setting, and 20.25% on S2 setting.
reputation: EPIC-Kitchens is a widely used benchmark in egocentric video understanding and action recognition, with a long-standing public leaderboard and active community use.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; scores are task- and split-dependent (S1/S2), and the dataset is challenging due to fine-grained actions, object interactions, and egocentric viewpoint.
